gloss: to detest; to abhor; to loathe

definitions.gloss: to detest; to abhor; to loathe
definitions.explanation: to hate something so strongly that one avoids it or finds it repulsive

examples.japanese: ⟦{暴力|ぼうりょく}→暴力：02528_bouryoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{忌|い}み{嫌|きら}われるべきだ。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{忌|い}み{嫌|きら}う⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
examples.english: He is a person who abhors injustice.

examples.japanese: ⟦かつて→かつて：10303_katsute⟧{忌|い}み{嫌|きら}われて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{食材|しょくざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{珍味|ちんみ}→珍味：05752_chinmi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。
examples.english: An ingredient that was once loathed is now popular as a delicacy.

notes:
A compound verb combining {忌|い}む (to shun as taboo) and ⟦{嫌|きら}う→嫌う：02048_kirau⟧ (to dislike), creating a word that expresses an intense, visceral aversion. Stronger than simply ⟦{嫌|きら}う→嫌う：02048_kirau⟧, it implies that the object of hatred is seen as morally wrong or deeply offensive.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{忌|い}み{嫌|きら}う: to detest lies
- ⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{忌|い}み{嫌|きら}う: to abhor injustice
- ⟦{暴力|ぼうりょく}→暴力：02528_bouryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{忌|い}み{嫌|きら}う: to loathe violence
- {忌|い}み{嫌|きら}われる: to be loathed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{嫌|きら}う→嫌う：02048_kirau⟧: to dislike; much milder than {忌|い}み{嫌|きら}う
- ⟦{憎|にく}む→憎む：00318_nikumu⟧: to hate; focuses on hostility toward a specific person or thing
- ⟦{毛嫌|けぎら}い→毛嫌い：13216_kegirai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have an irrational dislike or prejudice against; implies the dislike is not based on reason

ETYMOLOGY:
From {忌|い}む (to avoid as taboo or inauspicious) + ⟦{嫌|きら}う→嫌う：02048_kirau⟧ (to dislike). The combination intensifies the hatred and adds a dimension of moral rejection.
